rationale: The plan correctly specifies ~batch + condition with control as reference, fit via DESeq2 Wald (and a cross-checked edgeR QL), matching the balanced two-batch, n=6/group design; normalization (median-of-ratios/TMM) stays internal to each count model with no pre-adjustment, and QC (blind VST PCA/distances/library size colored by batch and condition) precedes testing with an explicit outlier-flagging policy. The low-count filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) is minimal and justified by group size, and BH FDR at 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage and independent filtering is stated explicitly with in-test thresholds. Enrichment is well-specified (full ranked list, Wald stat as stated metric, named/versioned Hallmark and Reactome collections, 15-500 window, universe = tested genes) though the ranking metric choice is 'disputed' per the plan itself, a minor deduction; the added edgeR overlap step is extra robustness beyond the reference but not wrong. The final report is exceptionally complete: design, versions, thresholds, tested/DE counts, overlap, caveats, and reproducibility (seed, session info) are all named.
